body.name: Key management process implemented
body.description: Cryptographic keys are managed across their lifecycle.
body.detail: Hashing needs no keys; the service credentials that do exist come from environment configuration with no rotation mechanism.
observations: SHA-256 chaining is keyless, so there is no signing key to steal — the trade-off is that the chain proves integrity, not origin.
Postgres and Neo4j credentials are injected from environment.
GAP: development defaults ship in config. A real deployment must override every one and rotate on a schedule.
